text: Fast and loud the strings ignite Running wild on Frisco night History folks with missing legs McCoyotes creeping back through time Never thought they'd roam again Past the bridges, city bends We drove them out in olden days But hung their finds each modern way Stealing fog, the golden gate Open pathway, shipping fate They're marrying the maid, they're playing Spreads the past, it's not the same Lives are drawn in yards and hearts Sidewalk beatings, dog bark barks Debate in every wobble bar Are we safe for Hoibor?
